description: Performance ads. With key_id and signing_secret_hex (or postback_token) of your credential, signs a test event for a sandbox click and sends it to the live event endpoint: verified true in the answer means the order will be accepted. Without credentials it only simulates the event against goals and verifies nothing. Costs nothing either way.

amount_usd.description: Decimal string, for an event that carries an amount.

api_key.description: The API key of the account (can_live_...). Optional when this MCP connection sends it as the Authorization: Bearer header.

customer_id.description: Your own id for the customer. Never an email address.

event.description: The event name, for example signup or deposit: lower case letters, digits and underscores.

event_id.description: A unique id for the event. Made for you when left out.

goals.description: Goals of the order, to see which ones the event would complete.

key_id.description: credential.key_id (bpk_...), to send a signed live event.

postback_token.description: The credential's postback token (advpb_...), to send the live event as a postback instead.

properties.description: Flat values your goal rules filter on.

signing_secret_hex.description: The credential's signing secret, with key_id.

name: send_sandbox_event
title: Send a sandbox test event
